versions.changelog:
info-collector v1.0.1

- No functional or documentation changes; all files remain unchanged from the previous version.

Initial release of info-collector:

- Provides real-time aggregation of the latest information on any specific topic from multiple public sources.
- Supports structured, category-based output (official updates, media reports, community/social discussions, developer ecosystem, market signals, in-depth analysis).
- Features authenticity verification, intelligent deduplication, event tagging, and priority sorting.
- Includes configurable input parameters (topic, time window, output language).
- Applies sentiment analysis, event labeling, and entity extraction for each piece of information.
- Outputs comprehensive, structured summary reports with core findings and actionable insights.
